content.text:
**Analyzing Input Patterns**

My focus has been on dissecting the input structure, specifically the dimensions of 4x9. I'm identifying distinct color regions and their bounding box sizes. I'm currently detailing the magenta elements, noting their 4x3 size and two 2x1 holes.
